**Issue #4593 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4593: Patch: the Infinite Assault, C9, Singularity
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part of #4601, the cards' fullsend tree (and of the tracker #4576). Card part **C9**: replace the stub scripts
CF (#4602) wrote for the cards below with their scripts and tests, base and Radiant, as cards of a held
single-player set. It builds beside the other card parts on the tree's integration branch; players see nothing
until the release (R).

The plan of record is [`docs/infinite-assault.md`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk/docs/infinite-assault.md): on `main` once C1 (#4577) merges, and until then on the planning branch `claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk`. Where it and SPEC disagree, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). Read its IA11 (the set, its ids, its hold, its tags and the design rules) and the comment CF leaves on
#4601 listing the verbs the set lacks.

Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), its rows for a card of a set that has not shipped above
all, and `spec/README.md` with the sections and rulings the cards touch (rule 1).

**Owns:** its cards' script files (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/cNNN_slug.rs`, IA-193 to IA-216
and their tokens), each entry's `loc` (`cargo jackioh catalog loc <path>`), and its own cards' rows in the
shared tables only where its build decides otherwise. CF wrote every other row. A verb, keyword or board fact the
engine lacks goes in the engine by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, in a file of its own where it can, with as few lines
in the shared engine files (`effects/mod.rs`, `script.rs`, `query.rs`, `wire/events.rs`) as possible, and its
test; the reconcile settles a seam with another part's.

## The cards

Card numbers are written `IA-n` here; in the spec and the catalog they are the set's own (`IA #25`,
`infiniteassault-025`, its tokens `infiniteassault-025-1`).

#### IA12.9 Singularity, IA-193–IA-216

Slow, then sudden: Units that grow every turn, Dormant giants, falling costs and one telegraphed clock.
The player wins by answering it early.

- **IA-193 Seedling Mind** — (1) Unit, Common, 1/2. End of turn: Gain +1/+1. *Radiant:* 2/4. … +2/+2.
- **IA-194 Compute Shard** — (1) Unit, Common, 0/3. Start of turn: The most expensive card in your hand costs (1) less. *Radiant:* 0/6. … (2) less.
- **IA-195 Power Law** — (2) Unit, Common, 2/2. Cry: Gain +1/+1 for each Infinite Assault card you've played this game. *Radiant:* 4/4. … +2/+2 …
- **IA-196 Emergent Behavior** — (2) Spell, Common. Give a friendly Unit +1/+1 for each turn you've started this game. *Radiant:* … +2/+2 …
- **IA-197 Long Context** — (2) Unit, Common, 3/3. Cry: Draw a card. Your hand holds 12 cards. *Radiant:* 6/6. Cry: Draw two cards. …
- **IA-198 Growth Spurt** — (1) Spell, Common. Give a friendly Unit +2/+2. It gains +1/+1 at the end of each of your turns. *Radiant:* +4/+4 … +2/+2 …
- **IA-199 Patient Machine** — (2) Unit, Common, 5/6. Dormant for 1 turn. *Radiant:* 10/12. … When this awakens, deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
- **IA-200 Superintelligence Seed** — (2) Unit, Common, 1/1. Dormant for 3 turns. When this awakens, transform it into an Ascendant. *Radiant:* 2/2. … a Radiant Ascendant.
  - **IA-200.1 Ascendant** — token, (4) Unit, 12/12.
- **IA-201 Overparameterized** — (3) Unit, Common, 6/6. Costs (1) less for each other Unit you control. *Radiant:* 12/12.
- **IA-202 Exponent** — (3) Unit, Rare, 2/2. Start of turn: Double this's Attack. *Radiant:* 4/4. … Double this's Attack and Health.
- **IA-203 Compute Cluster** — (2) Field Spell, Rare. Start of turn: Your Units gain +1/+1. *Radiant:* … +2/+2.
- **IA-204 Moore's Law** — (1) Spell, Rare. The Units in your hand cost (1) less. *Radiant:* The cards in your hand cost (1) less.
- **IA-205 Doomsday Clock** — (2) Unit, Rare, 0/8. Can't attack. In 4 turns: Deal 10 damage to the enemy hero. *Radiant:* 0/16. … 20 damage …
- **IA-206 Thought Accelerator** — (2) Unit, Rare, 2/4. Cry: Your Dormant Units awaken. *Radiant:* 4/8. … They gain +2/+2.
- **IA-207 Recursive Self-Improvement** — (2) Spell, Rare. Give a friendly Unit +2/+2. Shuffle a copy of this into your deck that gives +2/+2 more. *Radiant:* +4/+4 … +4/+4 more.
- **IA-208 Emergence** — (2) Trap, Rare. Reveals at the start of your opponent's turn while you control three or more Units: Give your Units +3/+3. *Radiant:* … +6/+6.
- **IA-209 Takeoff** — (3) Spell, Epic. Double a friendly Unit's Attack and Health. *Radiant:* … It has Rush.
- **IA-210 Matrioshka Brain** — (4) Unit, Epic, 10/20. GIGA, Taunt. *Radiant:* 20/40.
- **IA-211 Grey Goo** — (3) Unit, Epic, 1/1. End of turn: Transform a random adjacent Unit into a copy of this. *Radiant:* 2/2. … two random adjacent Units …
- **IA-212 Inevitable** — (2) Field Spell, Epic. End of turn: Give your Units +1/+1 for each turn this has been on the field. *Radiant:* … +2/+2 …
- **IA-213 The Long Game** — (4) Unit, Epic, 8/8. Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, destroy every enemy Unit. *Radiant:* 16/16.
- **IA-214 Emergent Mind** — (4) Unit, Legendary, 4/4. Start of turn: Gain +1/+1 for each card you played last turn. *Radiant:* 8/8. … +2/+2 …
- **IA-215 The Optimizer** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 3/6. End of turn: Transform a random card in your hand into a random Infinite Assault card that costs (1) more. *Radiant:* 6/12. … two random cards …
- **IA-216 The Singularity** — (4) Spell, Mythic. Summon a Singularity. *Radiant:* Summon a Radiant Singularity.
  - **IA-216.1 Singularity** — token, (4) Unit, 0/30. Taunt, Can't attack. In 5 turns: If this is still on the field, you win the game. *Radiant:* 0/60, In 4 turns.

## The design rules (IA11)

**The design rules every card part keeps.**

1. **Real cards.** Each card is legal in an ordinary game and plays the same in any mode; none reads the
   mode or its level. Commons to Legendaries of the doctrines and the Core sit on JackiOh's curve (costs
   (0) to (4); about 4 stats at (1), 8 at (2), 12 at (3), 16 at (4) for a Unit with little text, less with
   more), so they can be reused. Commander cards are boss cards, above the curve on purpose.
2. **Spicy, never unfair.** Swingy and rule-bending is the point, but every threat has an answer the player
   can see coming: a countdown is shown, a wall can be killed, a bluff can be called. Nothing makes the
   player lose with no counterplay, and nothing locks them out of playing for a turn they can't foresee
   (Kill Switch, IA-140, fires on a third card, which the player may choose not to play).
3. **Expressible.** The text uses verbs, keywords and filters the engine has (§6); where a card needs a new
   one, its part adds it by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, with its test. Numbers are `params` (`{damage}`),
   never literals (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
4. **Radiant is about twice the base face** (R275): doubled stats and a better line, never stats alone for
   a Unit with text. Each part writes its `docs/radiant-audit.md` rows.
5. **"Infinite Assault card"** in a card's text is a pool that names the set, which reaches the set while
   it is held (R1846001: a pool that names its set keeps to it). "Created" is the engine's Created mark.
6. **The AI must pilot it.** A card whose prompt the AI can't answer well is fixed or redesigned in its
   part, not shipped hoping.
7. **The part may tune.** A part may change a number, a word or a Radiant line where the engine or balance
   asks, keeping the card's role and its spice, and says so in its pull request; a bigger change goes in a
   ruling note.

## Done when

- Every card's script plays its base and Radiant faces by its §8.13 row, with tests in the same file for both
  (CLAUDE.md rule 6), and its `STUB (#4602)` header is gone; its entry's `loc` is the script's.
- Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note in this issue's block, a test named after it, and a
  paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3).
- Every new prompt is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
  --cards <each of its ids>` is green; `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for its cards.
- Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).

Blocked by #4602
```

# Plan draft #4593 (C9 Singularity, IA-193..216)
Status: reading. Nothing done by earlier run (interrupted before start).
- 26 stub scripts in crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c193..c216 (+ c200_1, c216_1)
- C2 (#4586) build pass 1 at HEAD: pattern source (c025..c048, engine files effects/cost.rs, player_mods.rs, ...)
## Findings so far (engine survey)
- Dormant: StaticFlags.slumber = SlumberText{turns: Some(N), wakes_by: None}; `when_this_awakens(id, |ctx,_|..)` trigger (slumber.rs); pattern stinkyscape/c019_imprisoned_cosmality.rs. `awaken(AwakenArgs{target})` verb (effects/statuses.rs) — c137 firststrike uses instance target. Helpers: is_slumbering, units_on_field_of (zones) keeps Dormant; active_units_of drops them.
- Countdown "In N turns": `delay` with `turns`, `label`, `watch` (self id, dropped when it leaves field R174), `mark` (R437). Pattern stinkyscape_plus/c079 (delayed hook -> win_game). R1181000.
- win_game(WinGameArgs{player}) effects/win.rs.
- grants.rs = granted Death only. Growth Spurt -> plan: self-rearming delay chain (end of turn, watch unit, next:true) — no engine change.
- shuffle_into has `memory`, `buff`, `costMod`, `copyOf` (c019_infinite_scroll pattern). Recursive SI: memory key holds the extra.
- Hand cost: set_cost_mod per hand card via for_each_card (meditative/c007). discount_random_in_hand (perks.rs).
- transform / transform_random (query set+cost, radiant "keep") pattern c012_recompile. R4577006 printed cost.
- Hand size: meditative c079 pattern.
- Per-set play count missing: GameLog.played_by_tag only; add played_by_set written only for single-player sets (D14). query::played_this_game_with_tag (query.rs:513) pattern.
- "played last turn": turn_log rebuilt for both players each turn start (turn.rs begin_turn ~328). No record. Plan: card-local memory (end_of_turn remember cards_played_this_turn; start_of_turn read).
## Run 3 (claude-8) progress
- Catalog rows read (CF text differs from issue: 197 "For the rest of the game, your hand size is {handSize}", 199 R has {damage}, 208 "{units}", 210 R adds Divine Shield, 213 R "and draw a card"; 194/204 print literal (1)/(2) with no params).
- spec/08-catalog.md §8.13 rows 1298-1323: Engine cell "STUB (#4602)..." must be rewritten, end "Built by C9 (#4593)." (C2 pattern rows ~1120-1145)
- C2 commit 6f78626a9d = template (70 files: scripts, engine verbs, rules tests crates/engine/tests/rules/hallucination.rs, ai test crates/ai/tests/ai/hallucination.rs, spec/pending/4586.md, R4586000..010).
- Effects built as `verb(json_as(json!({...})))` (stinkyscape/c019, classic/c063). Script fields: cry, start_of_turn, end_of_turn, delayed, triggers, static_flags, cost_aura, targets, resume.
- "arrived" trigger (played or summoned): stinkyscape_plus/c120_crawler.rs `arrived()` on GameEventType::Summoned, instance_id == live_self id. Use for 205/216.1 countdown start.
- delay: DelayArgs{at:{phase,player}, step, hook, data, watch, next, mark, turns, label} (effects/delay.rs:94); c079 S+ Glimpse = turns+label+delayed hook win_game(json!({})).
- Trap on opponent turn start: classic/c063 TriggerDef TurnStarted .with_when (player check). 208 = player != controller && active_units_of(controller).len() >= units.
- Dormant (R1839000): active_units_of drops Dormant (not Units, no effect reaches, triggers off).
